selection_contract.claim_boundary: no confirmatory, superiority, generalization, or manuscript claim may be made from four optimizer roots
selection_contract.correction_gate: component and total correction each improve at least five percent over zero in two environments, regress no more than five percent in any environment versus all three controls, and Hopper mean total correction remains at most 0.25
selection_contract.hindsight_diagnostic: macro_mean remains a non-adoptable diagnostic because it uses later states in the current macro interval
selection_contract.isolated_change: the v23 causal control projects the sampled lower action at the upper decision; the v24 candidate previews the same projector with the lower policy distribution mean from that same forward pass
selection_contract.matched_control: all four arms use terminal-reserve projection, identical capacity, training paths, heldout paths, budgets, and checkpoint window
selection_contract.mechanism_gate: only the policy-mean arm records same-state policy-mean targets, with positive sampled-versus-mean target delta during training; its upper consistency MSE improves by five percent in at least two environments and regresses by no more than five percent in any environment versus the v23 first-sample control
selection_contract.numerical_diagnostic: Dykstra step-tolerance convergence is reported but is not treated as certificate feasibility; every returned action is checked separately
selection_contract.outcome_use: development screen only; a pass authorizes fresh-root confirmation
selection_contract.question: does a deterministic lower-policy mean evaluated at the same causal decision state reduce upper-target noise without sacrificing reward or terminal-reserve correction
selection_contract.reward_gate: the candidate stays within five percent of zero, v23 causal, and hindsight controls in every environment; wins at least eight of twelve paired roots and at least two of four roots per environment versus v23; and improves mean reward versus v23 in at least two environments
selection_contract.safety_gate: every arm has zero certificate violations, fallback at most 0.05, and realized prefix power within the frozen budgets
selection_contract.selection_rule: advance only the policy-mean candidate if every frozen gate passes; otherwise stop. No metric-dependent parameter or threshold changes are permitted after execution
